== Usage ==
The license value inserted when a contributor picks '''"Original work — creator retains copyright"''' from the Licensing dropdown on <code>Special:Upload</code>. Use for original diagrams/graphics you made yourself that are '''not''' a screenshot of the game — an in-game screenshot should use {{tl|License-ED screenshot}} instead, even though you captured it, since the underlying game assets aren't yours to license.

The outer notice uses the <code>noexcerpt</code> class so maintenance/editorial
text is excluded from article excerpts and Page Previews.
